messages:
ella-cs: quick heads-up - Horizon Sentinel onboarding: they want APAC + EU allowlist + temporary rate bump for a customer demo on 2026-04-02. Renewal convo next week; they mentioned degraded perf last month might impact renewal. Can ops/infra support a short-lived ramp and allowlist?

devon-ops: noted. can you share CIDRs and expected QPS? any mTLS requirement?

ella-cs: CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/26 and 198.51.100.16/28. Expected peak ~250 qps for a 3h demo (13:00-16:00 JST). No mTLS for demo, but they need header-whitelist for tracking (X-Cust-Demo).

sanjay-net: we can add CIDRs to egress allowlist. recommend temp-rate window + burst policy. who owns auto-revoke timeline?

morgan-cs: i'll confirm exact demo time with customer and request written sign-off for auto-revoke. prefer auto-revoke at +6h after window end.

olivia-traffic: capacity check: APAC pool headroom ~1.6x for that slot. if concurrent spikes happen, route non-critical traffic to EU fallback. propose APAC primary, EU fallback with +60ms latency tolerance.

devon-ops: config draft:
```
allowlist:{
  "customer":"horizon-sentinel",
  "cidrs":["203.0.113.0/26","198.51.100.16/28"],
  "regions":["ap-northeast-1","eu-west-1"],
  "window":"2026-04-02T04:00:00Z/2026-04-02T07:00:00Z",
  "auto_revoke":"6h"
}
rate_limit_override:{
  "peak_qps":250,
  "burst":400,
  "apply_to":"proxy-route:hs-demo",
  "rollback":"2026-04-02T13:10:00Z"
}
```

sanjay-net: looks good. i'll need approval ticket id to push CIDRs to edge ACLs and update routing. ping @deploy-bot with ticket id when ready.

ella-cs: creating ticket now. note: add header allowlist key X-Cust-Demo to ingress filters for tracing.

morgan-cs: added header requirement. i'll attach signed approval email into ticket once received.

deploy-bot: automated preflight checks - APAC pool headroom OK, EU fallback capacity OK, security scan: mTLS opt-in required for production (not needed for demo).

olivia-traffic: suggest enabling prefix KV cache warmup for their demo prompts to avoid cold-start tails. small script run at demo start should warm caches.

devon-ops: agreed. set cache_warmup:true in deployment job. schedule change to go live 15m before window.

ella-cs: timeline: 2026-04-01 23:00 UTC - final ticket + approval in. 2026-04-02 03:45 UTC - changes applied and warmup run. 04:00-07:00 UTC - demo window (JST afternoon). auto-revoke at 13:00 UTC (+6h).

morgan-cs: follow-up: i'll run a rollback runbook with customer and confirm renewal call slot next day.

devon-ops: action items: 1) devon to stage ACL & routing policy, 2) sanjay to await deploy-bot approval and apply, 3) olivia to run KV warmup, 4) morgan to attach approval email.

ella-cs: thanks all - please update the ticket with status. i'll loop in account exec for renewal prep. :pray:
